description: This file is the main FastAPI application module for the LPT.bin to CSV converter service. It defines API endpoints for health checks, path-based conversion, file upload and conversion, advanced conversion with custom parser configurations, and retrieving format information. It handles request validation, path resolution with security considerations, streaming uploads, and response generation, integrating with internal converter functions and models.
